nom: Origins Ginzing SPF 40 Energy-Boosting Tinted Moisturizer

avis.texte: It's nice they have new shades but they changed the formula. It's greasy and thick and doesn't give you that fresh glow like it use too. So sad.

avis.titre: Original tint is not for brown people!
avis.texte: I ordered this product by mistake because I thought I was ordering the Ginzing daily moisturizer with SPF 30 (which I use regularly). The subject product left my brown skin looking very ashy and unnatural. Who is this product made for? And just after I received the product, which was not delivered for weeks due to delays, Origins just started offering a few different shades. Which I am not inclined to try... I ordered 2 of these duds that I can't use and they are expensive. It was a waste of money.

The Origins Tinted Moisturizer has been my go to product for the past couple of weeks. The moisturizer is very lightweight and it does not feel heavy on your skin. It also does leave any residue. I usually apply a bit in the morning and by the afternoon it is still there. Also I think it smells great!

I was honestly a bit skeptical when I first received this in the mail because of how orange it looked, but it surprisingly blended fairly well. It didn't leave my skin looking greasy either and it's very lightweight. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

Very lightweight in my face. Leave a smooth and polish look. I receive so many compliments. I would buy and recommend this product. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This is a surprising product, in a good way! It's a tinted moisturizer, and to me that would mean that it has some color in it, right? Well first it does look like straight spf, but then it kind of blends into your skin like a foundation. I love it, however as someone with acne, it does like a little help but also kind of emphasizes the texture of my skin. So I've had to put a little foundation to cover it, and I can't wear it wi the out foundation because my pimples be pimpling lol. That's the only caveat. But it's a really innovative idea and I love it otherwise! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

An overall good tinted moisturizer. It goes on smoothly and gradually turns into the tinted color. The added SPF is nice because that's one less product you now have to use. It looked great and left my skin with a nice moisturized glow. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the GinZing SPF 40 Energy-Boosting Tinted Moisturizer with Caffeine for the last few weeks as the final step of my morning routine. Honestly I've been really liking it! If I'm moving around a lot that day or I don't reapply I do feel it ends up coming off, but it's great for small outings or chill days. The texture is great and it does blend very nicely. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I used this tinted moisturizer at the end of my daily morning skincare routine. I have dry skin and it felt moisturizing but not overly heavy. I liked the finish a lot!I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I got this for free for review purposes. I love this moisturizer really creamy it does give me a light tint in my face plus perfect for sunscreen I don't get sunburn on my nose or cheeks really effective plus non sticky I love the zesty scent it has non irritating for sensitive skin plus amazing for hot days

I use this product in the morning after finishing my normal skincare routine and I love how it gives me such a natural, effortless glow all while providing spf protection. I've been looking for a product just like this and so glad I finally found it! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.I use the product when I didn't felt like wearing any make up, it gave me a subtle glow and color. I specially like it for sun protection. I also used it under makeup and worked very well for my skin.

It's extremely easy to blend, It's very light weight but it does get oily if you have oily spots. Like near my noses I get more oily so around there it takes a bit to go though the skin.I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I used the Origins tinted moisturizer in the morning as part of my daily routine. It felt lightweight and comfortable on my skin without feeling heavy or greasy. I really enjoyed the smooth, creamy texture, and the scent was fresh and pleasant without being overpowering. It gave my skin a nice, natural-looking finish while helping even out my complexion. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Nervous from first look, blown away from finish
avis.texte: The orange packaging is so adorable and having the matching product container is the cutest color matches. The name of the color is shade 3. When I first applied the product on the back of my hand to see the color and for a softer blend. I was not prepared for the pinkish shade the foundation. Actually was very thrown off by the pinkish shade from the foundation . The blend and the practically perfect match to the skin is chefs kiss perfection.

I enjoyed the smell of this sunscreen, and it got the job done of protecting my skin in the heat! The tint looked great on me. After a while during the day, however, it felt greasy and gunky, and when washing or wiping it off, it would burn my eyes and under-eye area until fully washed off my face. If I ever sweat with this product on my face, pimples would appear almost instantly. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This product was a learning curve for me. It comes off very orange but with careful blending it gives a lovely finish on the skin. It makes my skin look rejuvenated and awake. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
Provides all day moisture for your skin. It protects you from the sun and gives your skin glowing radiance. I feel as though my skin had benefits since I started using it.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. Some of the things I liked about the product were the ingredients used to create it and the ability to skip a step in my skincare routine because it served as a moisturizer and SPF. One thing that I didn't like was that it left a white cast on my skin, and I'm already pretty light, so I was surprised to see the white cast. Another thing was that I did not like how thick the product was. I'm used to using thin SPF that I can smoothly apply on my face, but with this product, because it was so thick, I had a harder time applying it smoothly.

avis.titre: very good, too light for me
avis.texte: I really enjoyed this sunscreen however it was too light for my face. the color match wasnt 100% off but it did make me look a little ghost. the texture itself was very nice and blended well with my makeup. I recieved this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been looking for a sunscreen and the tinted moisturizer is a plus!I love that it gives a little bit of coverage. It smells like oranges which I kind of like, don't really notice an energy boosting effect though. Overall, I would recommend this product. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I have always struggled with foundation. But today the day has been saved by yours truly. Skin tint has always helped me get two benefits out of the way. Protecting my skin from the sun and giving me that doll like finish. This new skin tint by origins is so worth it. It is not cakey, very easy to apply and buildable. The more coverage you want you can add more layers. 10/10 will buy again. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
Love that it's is lightweight and gives me a natural glow. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This product gives such a nice glow to my skin. I got the lightest tint for my fair skin and it adds the perfect color to my face and love the SPF protection. It also smells like mandarins and is very refreshing! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been enjoying the GinZing Tinted Moisturizer every morning. I wasn't sure how it would work as the product comes out many shades lighter than my skin, but as I applied it, it blended perfectly on my face. The formula is lightweight and my face is moisturized afterwards. This tint leaves a nice glow, so it's perfect for no makeup days. It has a light citrus scent, but it's not overwhelming which I love. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: One of the Best Tinted Sunscreens I have Used
avis.texte: This product is one of the best tinted sunscreens that I have ever used! For starters, I have a deeper skin tone. So a lot of the tinted sunscreens don't blend in well with my skin tone at all. But this Origins product is the best!! It rubs in smoothly and makes my skin feel hydrated. It's definitely lightweight and has a light fragrance. (I did receive this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes). But this is absolutely a product I would refill up on once I run out!
Very lightweight and buildable, blends pretty good with skin, does not stick to dry patches.

Really nice product! I enjoyed the consistency of the product a lot. It wasn't too thick and cakey and it also wasn't runny. It blended really well and the lightest shade really worked well with my skin tone. I loved the scent as well which is a plus. I would recommend this to a friend. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This is perfect for those days where you don't want to do your makeup but still want some light easy coverage. It's lightly moisturizing and the SPF is perfect for everyday wear. The tint is pretty subtle which is good for a light coverage feel. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and reviewing purposes.

I have used the original version of this for MANY years and absolutely loved it! I have also recommended to many people. Having said that I do not like the new colored formula at all! The colors do not blend to my shade and the feel of it is thicker and heavier. Please please bring back the original

I've been using the GinZing™ SPF 40 Energy-Boosting Tinted Moisturizer with Caffeine in the morning as the last step in my skincare routine. It feels lightweight and blends easily into my skin without feeling greasy or heavy. The texture is smooth, and it gives my skin a healthy, natural-looking glow while providing light coverage. I also like the fresh citrus scent; it feels refreshing without being overpowering. It's a great option for days when I want a quick, natural look with added sun protection. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I used the Origins GZ Tinted Moisturizer as part of my morning routine after my skincare. It felt lightweight, hydrating, and comfortable on my skin without feeling greasy or heavy. The texture blended in easily and gave my complexion a natural, healthy-looking glow with just the right amount of sheer coverage to even out my skin tone. I also liked that it felt breathable throughout the day and didn't settle into dry areas. The subtle, fresh scent was pleasant without being overpowering. Overall, it's a great option for days when I want a natural, effortless look with added hydration. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I am loving this! It feels like a skincare, especially for your under eyes! My shade is a bit too light for my whole face, so I've been mixing with a foundation, or using it on my under eyes. And it looks great! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I enjoyed this product. It wasn't bad to start the day but I feel like with it being a tint as the day went on unfortunately it made me look ashy. I think it's perfect for short term things though! Like quick errands or photo shoots where you want your skin to look natural

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again 🙂‍↕️
avis.texte: I use the Origins Ginzing SPF 40 Tinted Moisturizer in the morning while getting ready for the day and it feels so lightweight on the skin and didn't had a strong scent and didn't smell bad which is good and I really like how it hydrated my skin throughout the day definitely recommend. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This product has an amazingly silky texture and goes on very matte so you don't look oily at all. It has the most wonderful citrus orange scent as well. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been loving the Origins GinZing SPF 40 Energy-Boosting Tinted Moisturizer! ☀️✨ It feels lightweight, blends easily into my skin, and gives me a healthy, natural glow without feeling greasy. I love that it combines skincare, hydration, and broad-spectrum SPF 40 in one step, making my morning routine so much easier. It evens out my complexion just enough for those no-makeup makeup days while keeping my skin looking fresh and radiant. Definitely a great everyday option if you're looking for lightweight coverage with sun protection! 💛🌿 | received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I was skeptical when I first opened the package because I am a bit darker than shade 4 but it blended so beautifully into my skin and leaves such a flawless look. My skin has been breaking out a little bit from travel and the amount of compliments I got on my skin was amazing! Definitely recommend.

This product was a learning curve for me. It comes off very orange but with careful blending it gives a lovely finish on the skin. It makes my skin look rejuvenated and awake. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

As a fair skinned person, I really like how this tint blurred my imperfections while also being SPF. I prefer to not wear heavy foundations so this tint really fit the bill. It's perfect for a no makeup makeup look. It's definitely lighter coverage but I like the glow it gave me while also protecting my skin from the sun. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed this tinted SPF! I got the lightest shade and the undertone is perfect. Not too warm or peachy. It's very subtle which I like but gives the skin a gorgeous radiance that makes you look so healthy. It didn't break me out or break up any other skincare on my face. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Not for Dry Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: I like how the shade blended in nicely on my skin and it didn't sting at all. There was a slight gray tone when I first applied it but then it went away. However, this started to flake off my skin after a few hours and broke me out on my cheeks and forehead. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. At first I was worried that I picked the wrong shade but it blends into my skin so well. I also like how it looks like a foundation, allowing me to cover up acne scars while still protecting my skin from the sun. However, it is a bit heavy especially if you wear the two fingers recommend amount for sunscreen so I wouldn't recommend wearing this during these hot summer months. I think it's maybe more suitable for the fall/winter. Also it can be a bit messy when applying and I wouldn't recommend applying with a brush or anything like that because it will just soak up a good amount of it. Personally I think I'd stick with my regular spfs.

This product was really good! It felt nice and light on my face. I love that it has sunscreen in it as well! I honestly couldn't see the tint super well on my skin. It's not super noticeable if I'm honest but I do like how it feels on my skin! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
This tinted moisturizer gives my skin a fresh, natural-looking glow.It provides just the right amount of coverage for everyday wear.The formula feels lightweight and keeps my skin hydrated all day.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I enjoyed using this product because I don't like having to apply SPF on top of my foundation. This blended in well to my skin but it did get oily after a few hours.

Wow it is an amazing product. I have oily/dry skin and it moisturizes my skin so much. It is perfect for the day and night. My skin didn't look shiny but it felt very hydrated after using it. I recommend it 100%. It will be part of my routine. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
Such an amazing product, smells good and makes my skin very soft and smooth. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

It is such a disappointment that this product is no longer a regular tinted moisturizer that "finds the right tint" for your skin. It was such a good product because you didn't have to buy different shades as the seasons changed because this product as it USED TO BE would self adjust. Now you have to buy different shades for different times of year. Real disappointment for a product that I've been telling everyone about and enjoying over the last 13 years.

This tinted moisturizer from Origins (GinZing SPF 40) has become my favorite find for the warm season, when you don't want to overload your skin with thick foundation. It has a very interesting texture: when applied, it is whitish with small granules, but when distributed, they dissolve, and the cream adjusts to the skin tone, giving the same "sheer tint" effect. It won't cover serious flaws, but it will perfectly even out the overall complexion, remove dullness and give a very fresh, healthy, as if lit from within finish. A separate plus is SPF 40, which is ideal for protection for every day, and a pleasant, invigorating citrus scent that instantly refreshes in the morning. After it, the skin feels moisturized, soft and looks well-groomed without any mask effect. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
Studies have suggested that chemicals like octinoxate can contribute to coral bleaching. Because of this, it is banned in several locations, including Hawaii, Key West, and the U.S. Virgin Islands.

avis.titre: Coverage is uneven but great for spf
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product because the spf is so high and I love a good tinted moisturizer but it was so thick to put on. It felt like you were putting glue on your face and it was hard to apply evenly even with a brush. The color was not a true match to my skin but I feel like the consistency could have been better. I love origins and the brand and normally on point but this wasn't it for me.

This is sadly not for me. It made my eyes water and I didn't really apply it near them. They watered all day. However it does have a nice coverage with sunscreen benefits and a nice scent. Just because its not for me.doesnt mean it wont be for others. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: It works just not for the heat
avis.texte: This doesn't do well in really hot, sweaty weather. It will melt right off my face. It doesn't feel heavey or thick but it needs time to absorb some in my skin. During really hot days it sweats off; i think this is good for warm to cool days.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I actually loved this tinted moisturizer my Orgins. I am not an everyday makeup girlie and for me it's way too hot to wear tons of makeup. I love that this tinted moisturizer matches my skin tone and blends super easy and is super lightweight. The best thing of all it has SPF in it so that a huge plus for me. The only thing I didn't love is the moisturizer is super greasy I had to take a napkin and blot my face to turn down the oil look. All and all it's still and great product and I would definitely recommend!

I'm always very skeptical about when it comes to a tinted moisturizer or sunscreen but I was very pleasantly surprised. It makes me look perfectly smooth and shiny and I honestly love it! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This tinted moisturizer gives my skin a natural, healthy glow while providing reliable SPF 40 protection. The lightweight formula blends effortlessly, and the caffeine helps my complexion look fresh and energized. It feels comfortable all day, doesn't feel greasy, and works well under makeup. A great choice for everyday wear. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been on the hunt for a good tinted moisturizer so I was super excited for this one. Love that it's spf 40 and I've liked other origins products so I had much hopes. Unfortunately I feel like it left a gray cast on my olive skin. I also am not crazy about the smell (my husband said he liked the smell of it though so to each their own). The texture I liked though and didn't find that it felt really greasy or anything like that. I wish the color didn't leave a gray cast because then I think I would really like it. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: The best sunscreen in the world
avis.texte: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I've been using the Origins GinZing SPF 40 Tinted Moisturizer, and I'm genuinely impressed! It feels incredibly lightweight, blends seamlessly into my skin, and gives my complexion a healthy, natural glow without feeling heavy. I love that it combines hydration, sun protection, and a sheer tint all in one product. It's perfect for everyday wear, especially when I want a fresh "no-makeup" look. My skin feels moisturized, protected, and looks more even throughout the day. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for an easy, natural-looking tinted moisturizer with SPF!

I used this Origins Ginzing spf tinted moisturizer in the morning, and I really enjoyed how lightweight and smooth it felt on my skin. It blended easily without feeling greasy. It gave my complexion a healthy glow, and provided comfortable hydration with added sun protection throughout the day. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Love it as an SPF but not super moisturizing
avis.texte: I enjoy this tinted SPF. It feels more like an SPF than a moisturizer, but does give the skin a nice glow. This is lightly tinted but helps minimize the white cast from the SPF. It blended in easily and felt comfortable on the skin, but wasn't super hydrating. You may want to use a separate moisturizer if you are very dry. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes

Wow, as somebody who is generally pretty adverse to wearing sunscreen daily, this stuff makes me actively WANT to wear it! It's light, doesn't feel oily and soaks in well which is my main concern when using any type of sunscreen on my face. But the main benefit to me is the natural glow it gives you. It's very subtle and nothing too crazy but that's what makes it perfect. Just enough to make me look healthy…lol

I got the opportunity to try this product in shade 2. Upon using for the first time, I didn't expect it go on like sunscreen lotion would smell and look, but I was pleasantly surprised at my skin after application. This gave me such a beautiful bottom layer of makeup that just made me GLOW! It made my face one whole color which is something I struggle with. I am more than in love! The SPF is great too, did not burn after hours of yard work in the summer heat. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This really took me by surprise. Most spf moisturizers break my very sensitive and acne prone skin out, but I've had no issues at all with this product. What's even better is the light tint that is just enough for a no makeup look, and it goes so perfectly under makeup, I don't even need a primer. This is thick but absorbs well and after a minute or so dries all the way down with no tackiness or oily feeling. It leaves my skin feeling really soft and hydrated all day long. There is a citrus scent, but I have no issues with it causing irritation. This product was gifted to me for review purposes.

The product is great it's not too oily nor dry. Shade match was almost spot on a little white. It does have a strong smell that I don't really enjoy. Overall I recommend this and added this to my routine. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This is a great spf moisturizer that feels great in the skin. Its gentle and doesnt irritate my eyes. Its a comfortable formula : I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes
I have used it a couple of times now and I can say this tinted moisturizer and SFP is perfect for my dry skin. It gives perfect glow without making me oily plus it protects skin against sun.

I am absolutely loving this product! It gives my skin the perfect, healthy-looking glow and a beautiful sheer tint that blends in flawlessly. It feels super lightweight, hydrates my skin all day, and having SPF 40 built-in makes my morning routine so much easier. Perfect for that "no-makeup" makeup look!

I used this tinted moisturizer in the morning for the past days, and I have actually seen much improvement in my skin! There is less redness around my nose and cheeks, and the formula wasn't irritating. However, I do have combination skin so some areas that were oily looked a little patchy but overall I honestly enjoyed using this and will continue to use it sparingly for days I want a clean coverage look. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.
I loved too much the glow of how it looks during the day super natural, I loved it a lot and the hydration so soft that it feels

I'm so obsessed with this. It moisturizing and matches my skin tone. This is definitely going to be in my everyday routine. received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely love this tinted sunscreen. It's a perfect everyday sunscreen with a tiny touch of coverage. Or it can be the perfect base before you put on make up. The consistency is amazing and there is obviously no white cast. I would totally recommend. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes I really love this product I'm use this product daily very light weighted i am obsessed with this product

I am always wary of western tinted sunscreens because while they often nail the shade, the formula is greasy and just gross. I am so happ that this was NOT the case! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I was hesitant about this product at first since I have rather sensitive skin, however, I was pleasantly surprised and impressed after using it. Not only did it not cause my skin to burn and react, but the tint it provided was a nice minimal coverage. I will absolutely be adding this to my daily face routine. Overall, would definitely recommend to friends. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

Hi bestie!!! I'm here to share my honest review of the product the name is origins ginzing spf 40 I my whole life I don't use sunscreen. Im get a scard . Seen I get the product it's 2 in 1 it's not only sun green it's also light foundation. Girly what's also you guys want.. you get 2 in 1 I loved for my daily routine. Must try no regrets for sure .

avis.titre: Thought it was a sample size
avis.texte: My recent Origins order had all the products I love but the new packaging has shrunk the size. They are so small they seem like deluxe samples.
The color would flake off in patches on my face, and it was extremely uncomfortable to my eyes as soon as I applied it, so I had to throw the whole tube away.
This products matches my skin perfectly even with changes due to a suntan. This product adapts and matches perfectly.
I play pickleball everyday and this is an awesome lightweight mosterizer/sunscreen. The tint smooths out my skins blotchy look. I will never go out without this.

avis.titre: Leaves an ashy look on darker skin tones
avis.texte: I bought the SPF30 and was so happy with it not leaving my face white after application. Just was glowing everyday. Then a year later they took away the 30 in the stores and now only have the tinted 40 which leaves a white caste on my face that lasts for a good couple hours even after rubbing it in well. I would love more sun protection and I like that it's not scented but why make this tinted if it doesn't do what was intended? I took a pic but it's a pic hard to tell on camera, in person it's a pretty big difference

The SPF 15 version of this product was perfection. This one is cakey, settles in pores, has a strong, unpleasant odor, and stings my eyes no end. I end up crying every time I use it. The sunscreen is just too strong and thick. Every Origins product I have ever loved is gone. So much work to find the right products only to have them disappear.
I've been a loyal customer for years and I'm so thrilled this was brought back. My daily staple. Also, LOVING the new rebrand/packaging across the board ❤️

avis.titre: Not a replacement for the spf 15 version
avis.texte: I used the spf 15 version of this product since it first came out, it was my daily holy grail product that made my face look just the right amount of glowy and evened out without being "makeup". I liked that it was weightless, moisturizing and the coverage was sheer enough to not have to be precise with application. I have sensitive skin and I've never had a tint or bb cream or anything feel so good on my skin. This spf 40 version? Nope. Hate it. It gives me a greasy pallor and is too heavy on my skin. Instead of glowy it gives wax statue. I wish they would bring back the old spf 15 version. I've tried actually dozens of different tinted moisturizers since they discontinued it (and I ran out of the stash I bought up and stored in my fridge as soon as I found out!) and I haven't liked anything. I wear spf separately on my face I don't need it in my makeup making it terrible.

I don't like it. After washing your face, it feels like you still need to rinse because it feels like there's still product left on your skin. Besides that, it doesn't clean completely — it doesn't fully remove tinted sunscreen.

avis.titre: Great product, shipping isn't the same
avis.texte: I buy this all the time, it's great. It keeps me from burning all day even with just one application. My issue is the packaging. They used to send everything wrapped in tissue in a box. I got this in an envelope and the box was crushed. Since I'm using it for myself, it's ok. If I had bought this for a gift I'd send it back. Even though is doesn't effect the product, it looks used and I'd never want to give that to anyone. Origins used to be so much better, but like lots of companies they are cutting corners

avis.titre: I wanted to love it. Does not live up to Vitazing
avis.texte: I wanted to live this product so badly. I've used Vitazing for 20 years and it's honestly the only product I've found from any company that gives me the perfect skin like texture with a beautiful glow. Sadly, origins discontinued this product a couple years ago, but I've been able to find bottles of it floating around from different businesses. Well, it's officially gone and I can no longer get it. I thought this product would be just as good. I'm so disappointed it doesn't even compare and it left my skin feeling dry and cakey. ORIGINS- I beg you- please please please bring back Vitazing!!!!!

avis.titre: Please reformulate it with just Zinc
avis.texte: I love the color of this tinted moisturizer, but I stopped buying it because it has chemical sunscreens in it. I would love to keep buying this if it just had zinc, or please sell an option with only zinc.

avis.titre: I would not buy again as a "tinted" moisturizer.
avis.texte: This Origin's Ginzing SPF 40 is a wonderful sun protecting moisturizer but not very tinted. I would not buy again as a "tinted" moisturizer.
This blends perfectly with my skin. Very lightweight coverage, but just enough for the days I want it. It doesn't leave my skin greasy.
This was supposed to be the new product which replaced the former tinted moisturizer. It is not. My skin looked lighter. Too white. Very disappointed.

I started using this in the fall when I was looking for something to keep my skin moisturized and protected as well as keep my "glow". On a whim I tested this out in store on my hand and I was immediately hooked. It smelled great, my skin felt dewy and looked clean. The spf factor is what sold me! It's like an all in one product that refreshes your face and leaves you looking more awake and vibrant. The color blends well for neutral fair/medium skin tones and I've even used bare faced and being very pale with no issues. I love the scent as it's fresh and citrusey without being too strong. The price point is a little high but it's a very clean feeling formula and my skin has never looked better. I blend with my fingers or a foundation brush and get even coverage. If using yohr hands, its good to carry a wipe but i run into the backs of my hands for spf coverage as well! I LOVE this product!

I use this product every day and absolutely love the way it evens out skin tone without being overly tinted. I first apply a moisturizer and then the tinted moisturizer over that. With the SPF 40, I never have to worry about separate sunscreen on my face. I love this product!

I tested it and really liked this product.. It was a very mini version of mine and I like to test it for about a week.. for the right result...it has a very pleasant smell and a thin texture. I recommend this product to all my friends. This product was sent to me as a gift Topbox circle
I used the old 15 SPF version for years. I loved it. This one, not so much. I find it to be too heavy and weirdly enough, too much tint. I have to wash my hands when using.

This sunscreen does make my skin look brighter and fresher, but it's not moisturizing enough causing the cakey surface when looking carefully at it. This should be primed with other moisturizing products (serums, moisturizer,...) to avoid drying out the skin. I bought it during promotion time, but I think the quality should be enhanced to match its price.

I absolutely love this product! I have never spent a lot on beauty products in my life but decided to with this tinted moisturizer. It is fabulous! It helped conceal fine lines and made my skin look so much better! Even my husband noticed and said he thought it made my face look so much smoother! I am 54 and have fine lines and wrinkles and this product helps so much!

This is by far, my favorite moisturizer! This is a great every day look that you can quickly apply and goes on easily. I especially love it in the summertime. I just add a little blush and gloss and go. I've purchased this several times and will continue buying it.
Absolutely love this product! Covers my aging skin so smoothly and hides sun spots. I wish they had it in larger sizes.

avis.titre: Wanted to love this, but made me break out
avis.texte: I loved the coverage and color of this, but it made my skin break out in places I never break out. I tried it for several weeks to see if I'd adjust, but it kept getting worse. I've been a long time user of Origins products with no issue, so I was a bit surprised.

avis.titre: Amazing sunscreen! But, it has chemical ingredients
avis.texte: It applies very smoothly. Doesn't pill, doesn't leave a white cast, doesn't feel greasy. The product turns into tint as it's rubbed onto skin, the tint matches my skin tone perfectly. The product feels and looks great! Spf has great sun protection. My skin did feel refreshed and bright, so I'm still going to give it 5 stars because the product performed well. But … the ingredients include chemical sunscreen! The ingredients list shows Octinoxate 7.5%, Octisalate 2.0%, Octocrylene 2.0%, Titanium Dioxide 3.0%, Zinc Oxide 3.0% as active ingredients. Only zinc oxide and titanium oxide are mineral sunscreen. While Octinoxate, Octisalate, and Octocrylene are chemical sunscreen. Origins markets itself as an skincare line that uses natural ingredients, so this could be slightly misleading.
I wear this every day, the perfect, sun protective foundation. Blends perfectly, feels good, not heavy or oily. Cleans easily. Perfect every day of the year!

avis.titre: I keep coming back to this product.
avis.texte: I've been using this for over 10 years. I like the fresh no-makeup look I get with this tinted moisturizer. It's a fresh light look. My skin is fair with sun damage dark spots (life in So Cal) so this product helps blend everything w + SPF!
If you wear by itself no makeup at all then it works, but doesn't work well with concealer foundation cream anything. It separates and gets blotchy, not cute at all… hope i can return.

I've tried a lot of other products and I keep coming back to this one. I love the coverage of the tint. I layer over a vitamin c and moisturizer but I love this as my base during the summer. It evens my skin tone and the coverage feels great.

I had high hopes that I would be able to transition from the VITAZING SPF 15 to the GINZING SPF 40 after they discontinued it, but unfortunately, that has not happened. I loved the VITAZING and have been using it for years. One of my friend's owns a top beauty brand that is very popular for their tinted moisturizing serum but I always thought the VITAZING was better. GINZING Tinted moisturizer leaves a white cast on my skin that does not go away and it also feels heavier then the VITAZING. Please bring back the VITAZING so I can stop shopping for a product that I love like I loved the VITAZING. There's nothing else on the market like it.

I have been searching for a tinted moisturizer with spf to wear during Florida summers. I was really hopeful for this product because I have loved other Origins products in the past. My skin tone is light neutral. This tinted moisturizer was pretty dark and gave me an orange tint. I would guess that this should likely be used on light medium to dark skin tones. It was lightweight and smelled lovely, but just not for me.

This is great for a day for winery hopping, or any day you want a quick prep. It is not sweat/waterproof and does need to be reapplied if you are out in the direct sun, but for those errand days or light activities it is perfect. I never let it run out.
i love this stuff! its lightweight, blends nicely and makes my skin look so so good. however, if youre very fair skinned, this could leave you too orange.
This is amazing and so worth the price. I wear it almost daily.

I've used this for years as my foundation. It has just enough coverage and leaves a nice natural finish. SOooooo many other foundations/ bb creams/ etc always used to separate on my cheeks, but this never does.

avis.titre: I do buy this product again &  again &again PLease !
avis.texte: absolutely Love this product it is kind to my face and I use it as my primary makeup .just enough tint and moisture and a beautiful finish. Please don't make me start looking at T.J. Max for buyouts and discontinues Keep Origins at Ulta

Used on my husband with rosacea, light pinkish skin tone. Hid the redness nicely and subtly. It settled a bit on his undereye lines, i put some eye cream to moisturize and blend. He's bad about skincare but needs spf daily. The added skin tone evening was a nice plus.

avis.titre: I looked like an Oompa Loompa!
avis.texte: I like Origins, but I can't recommend this product. I have fair to light skin tone, and the color of this product was too orange for me. I wish it came in various shades to match your skin, but it doesn't. If I could return it, I would. Don't waste your money on this, seriously.

avis.titre: subtle but very impressed with this sunscreen
avis.texte: I used this after my skincare routine and went about my day.. the first time I looked in a mirror I stopped *wow my skin* ... it gives a minimal amount of coverage to just even out the skintone and a nice glow.

avis.titre: New higher SPF formulation is not for melanated skin
avis.texte: I used the SPF15 version of this very happily for years! That formulation seems to be gone, now replaced with this much higher SPF. As a person with melanated skin, I agree with the commenter below that this higher SPF formulation puts a white-ish cast on our faces that is not flattering and feels drying. Please bring back the SPF15 version, or create something different for medium to darker skin tones. This was my go-to every day and I'm definitely a bit disappointed. Still giving it three stars because those with lighter skin tones might still like it.

avis.titre: Draws attention to all of your wrinkles and pores
avis.texte: This looks ok in the mirror, but in natural light/photos it looks terrible. Like I said in title it really draws attention to every wrinkle and enlarged pore. Not for larger pore or early wrinkle skin, in my opinion.

I been using Origins Tinted Moisturizer for 3 years now. I love it, the formula is consistent, it is buildable for fuller coverage, and sets well with a powder. Highly recommend. I have a fair complexation and combo/dry skin.
Do not like this. It dries your skin. Wish I could return it.

I reluctantly bought this because of an Ulta employees recommendation. Boy am I glad I did. It goes on so perfectly and somehow blends in to my skin, which is on the fair side. It doesn't settle into fine lines at all. It looks like my skin but better.

As a redhead with freckles and sensitive skin this is my favorite tinted moisturizer. You only need a small amount for full face and neck coverage. You can apply it like sunscreen quickly in the morning and it will last all day even after mild exercise. It's tinted enough to protect my face from sunburns and cover my red spots, but also light enough so my freckles can show. Maybe not the most moisturizing - if you prefer a dewey look, then I recommend Origin's Perfect World lotion with SPF.
